course.title: Unit 6 Changing for the seasons--Lesson A-【例句】
course.description: Unit 6 Changing for the seasons--Lesson A-【例句】

sentences.content: It's your dad's. Put it there, please.
sentences.english: It's your dad's . Put it there , please
sentences.chinese: 这是你爸爸的。请把它放在那里。

sentences.content: Can I wear this new shirt today?
sentences.english: Can I wear this new shirt today ?
sentences.chinese: 我今天可以穿这件新衬衫吗？

sentences.content: Yes, but wear a coat too. It's cold and windy outside.
sentences.english: Yes , but wear a coat too . It's cold and windy outside
sentences.chinese: 好的，不过也要穿件外套。外面又冷风又大。
这件紫色连衣裙是妈妈的。

sentences.content: Spring, summer, autumn and winter. Warm, hot, cool and cold.
sentences.english: Spring , summer , autumn and winter . Warm , hot , cool and cold
sentences.chinese: 春、夏、秋、冬。温暖、炎热、凉爽、寒冷。

sentences.content: In spring, wear a sweater. In summer, wear shorts.
sentences.english: In spring , wear a sweater . In summer , wear shorts
sentences.chinese: 春天穿毛衣，夏天穿短裤。

sentences.content: In autumn, wear a jacket. In winter, wear a lot!
sentences.english: In autumn , wear a jacket . In winter , wear a lot !
sentences.chinese: 秋天穿夹克，冬天裹严实！

sentences.content: What do you wear in the snow?
sentences.english: What do you wear in the snow ?

sentences.content: Who can tell me? Who knows?
sentences.english: Who can tell me ? Who knows ?
